By way of the present application, the applicant seeks anticipatory bail in FIR No.370/2023 under Sections 498A/304B/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC) registered at Police Station Palam Village, Delhi.
2. The applicant is stated to be the cousin sister of the deceased as well as the wife of the brother-in-law of the deceased.
It is further stated that she is the one who had organized the match for the wedding between the deceased and the brother-in-law of the applicant, namely, Umesh Kumar.
3. It is also noted that the applicant is a widow and has school going minor children.
She is also looking after the minor child of the deceased.
4. Vide order dated 20th July, 2023, the applicant was granted interim protection by this Court subject to the applicant joining investigation and cooperating in the investigation.
This is a digitally signed order.

In the Status Report been filed on behalf of the State, it is stated that the applicant has joined investigation and is cooperating in the investigation.

6. Learned APP opposes the grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant on the ground that the applicant has been named in the FIR and in the statements of the relatives of the deceased recorded under Section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (CrPC).
7.
Charge-sheet has already been filed in the present case.
8. Considering the above facts and circumstances, the Court is of the considered view that the applicant is entitled to grant of anticipatory bail.

Consequently, in the event of arrest in FIR No.
370/2023, the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one surety of the like amount subject to the satisfaction of the arresting officer/Station House Officer (SHO) concerned and further subject to the condition that the applicant shall join the investigation as and when directed and not influence any witness/complainant or tamper with the evidence of the case.

9. Needless to state that in the event the applicant does not join or cooperate in the investigation,
the State shall be at liberty to take appropriate steps in this regard.
10. The application stands disposed of in above terms.

AMIT BANSAL, J.
SEPTEMBER 19, 2023 rt
